metadata.dataset: Two public example HL-60 membrane-flow movies, De Belly, Yan et al., Cell 2023
metadata.analysis_unit: one example movie per condition; frames are repeated observations, not independent cells
metadata.quantity: fluorescent membrane-marker peak motion using the published approximate spatial coordinate, NOT force
metadata.coordinate_note: Author unrolling coordinate: averaged boundary samples mapped with mean horizontal/diagonal pixel distance. Not an independently calibrated contour arclength; absolute speed should be validated before reuse.
metadata.common_window_note: First 22 analyzed frames chosen because the protrusion author notebook fits 22. The control notebook fits 60; those extra frames remain available separately. Movie starts are not aligned to verified stimulation onset.
metadata.no_force_inference: No force, FRET, sensor construct, calibration, or mESC data in these two movies.
